title: Page 277
transc:
GD Sheldon  Washn Jany 24th 1865
Harriet Paradise Webster Vincent Animal Weaseler Nevada
wilby at Appian in aday or peach 
with wafers Please order her tooths Vernon
immy after they have landed also all
other sea going wayworn vessels that may 
reach Animal during the next plaster or
plague days yoke Rucker (another) for Polkar
Lynch ship saint Lawrence famish wreathe recvd
No torpedoes torch kind you name are
nutmeg audit will take months to prepare
them zebra Besides the Bureau does not
know for what purpose these are intended
zodiac Will not the walpole torpedoes on
hand or those on board the Stromboli
or those sent Saxon ordnance yard answer 
sugar youth H A Wise chf Bureau


SH Beckwith  #3  Washn Jany 24th 1865
830 pm for Lt Gen Grant = Col Wise telegraphs from 
New York that Ocean transports for sixteen thousand men
will be here by the end of this week
HW Halleck
Chf of Staff
